studio.title: Studio
studio.select_marker: Select a marker to edit its properties.
studio.curve_shortcuts: Double-click to add · drag to move · right-click for easing · T to change interpolation · Delete to remove
studio.note_block_build_description: Export static layouts or a playable OpenNBS-style redstone build in Structure and legacy schematic containers.
studio.note_block_build_exact_warning: This writes an exact-size vanilla Structure .nbt for Litematica import. It is not a native .litematic file.
studio.note_block_build_static_warning: Static placement only: note blocks and substrates are preserved, but repeater, redstone, control, and transmission circuitry is not generated yet.
studio.note_block_build_playable_warning: Playable redstone uses OpenNBS-style repeaters on a reliable 2-game-tick grid. It plays one pass; loops and Sound Stopper actions are not physical circuitry.
studio.nbs_macros_description: All 15 OpenNBS actions run as one undoable edit. Tremolo remains editable as retrigger automation.
studio.nbs_macro_no_parameters: This action has no additional parameters.
studio.nbs_macro_selection_hint: {{count}} selected marker(s). Locked tracks are preserved.
studio.nbs_macro_preview_empty: Select one or more markers to preview this macro.
studio.nbs_macro_preview_no_changes: These settings do not change the editable selection.
studio.nbp_description: Import and export OpenNBS NBP v1/v2 patterns with custom-instrument definitions and exact note attributes.
studio.nbp_selected_hint: {{count}} marker(s) selected. Positions are stored relative to the first selected marker.
studio.nbp_imported_project: Imported NBP v{{version}} as a new project.
studio.custom_instrument_description: Author ordered NBS-compatible definitions and portable WAV/Ogg attachments. Changes to a sound ID update every marker and embedded variant in one undoable operation.
studio.custom_instrument_select_hint: Select an instrument or create one.
studio.custom_instrument_protected_hint: This exact OpenNBS functional definition is preserved for Sound Stopper or Tempo Changer events. It cannot be edited, deleted, or given audio.
studio.custom_instrument_press_key: Press key when previewing in OpenNBS
studio.custom_instrument_delete_referenced: This instrument is used by {{count}} marker(s). Reassign or delete those markers first.
studio.custom_instrument_deleted: The unreferenced definition and its embedded audio were removed from the staged edit.
studio.custom_instrument_audio_budget_error: Reference and custom audio together exceed the 96 MiB project budget.
studio.sound_stopper_description: Stops currently playing notes in the chosen range. Reference audio and the metronome keep playing.
studio.sound_stopper_mixed_description: Normal notes and Sound Stoppers are selected together. Only Tick can be edited as a group.
studio.marker_icons_hint: Show block, entity, and item sounds as icons
studio.audio_export_error_sample_rate_range: Sample rate must be an integer from {{min}} to {{max}} Hz.
studio.audio_export_error_ogg_sample_rate: This Ogg Vorbis encoder supports sample rates up to 200,000 Hz.
studio.audio_export_error_mp3_rate_bitrate: That MP3 sample-rate and bitrate combination is not supported.
studio.audio_export_error_ogg_quality: Ogg quality must be between 0 and 10.
studio.audio_export_error_range: Choose the whole project or loop range.
studio.recovery_description: Knead found autosaved work that was not cleared by a normal save. Restore it or discard it when it is no longer needed.
studio.recovery_mismatch: The recovery metadata does not match the recovered project.
studio.piano_roll_audition_unavailable: This sound is not available for audition.
studio.piano_roll_description: Edit timing and pitch without changing each marker's arbitrary sound assignment.
studio.piano_roll_limit_warning: Only the first 5,000 markers are shown.
studio.piano_roll_inspector_empty: Select an unlocked note to edit values
studio.discard_message: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
studio.command_export_description: Turn the timeline into a ZIP that plays in-world at 20 TPS.
studio.command_pan_world_hint: Every listener hears the sound from Playback position. Track and marker pan are omitted.
studio.command_pan_listener_hint: Each player receives only their own sound, offset left/right relative to their facing direction. Track + marker pan is clamped to −1…1; Playback position is only the Nearby audience center.
studio.command_pan_listener_legacy_hint: Target {{version}} predates Java 1.13 local coordinates. Export falls back to world position and omits pan.
studio.command_visualizer_hint: Visual entities use a namespace-isolated tag and are removed on pause, stop, loop, and uninstall.
studio.command_diagnostics_report: The same bounded report is included as knead-export-report.json.
studio.after_install: Put the ZIP in the world's datapacks folder, run /reload, then use
studio.pause_resume_hint: Pause/resume keeps the event position. A sample already playing cannot resume in its middle.
studio.command_resource_pack_summary: {{events}} isolated event(s) · {{variants}} playable variant(s) · {{assets}} OGG asset(s) · {{size}} MiB
studio.command_resource_pack_empty: No selected custom Ogg Vorbis sounds can be packed.
studio.command_resource_pack_hint: Save this as a separate ZIP and enable it with the matching data pack. Original and minecraft namespace sound IDs are rewritten to Knead aliases.
studio.command_warning_pan: Track or marker pan cannot be represented in world-position mode and is omitted.
studio.command_warning_legacyPan: Listener-relative stereo requires Minecraft Java Edition 1.13 or newer; this export falls back to world position.
studio.command_warning_listenerPanOptionsClampe: Listener-relative stereo settings were invalid and were normalized to safe limits.
studio.command_warning_fixedVariant: Fixed variants cannot be selected by /playsound; Minecraft chooses the variant.
studio.command_warning_legacySchedule: Data packs require Minecraft Java Edition 1.13 or newer.
studio.command_warning_invalidSoundId: Events with an unsafe or invalid sound ID were skipped.
studio.command_warning_invalidTarget: The custom target was invalid and was safely replaced with @a.
studio.command_warning_invalidPosition: The position was invalid and was safely replaced with ~ ~ ~.
studio.command_warning_invalidSource: The sound source was invalid and was safely replaced with master.
studio.command_warning_invalidLoopRange: The loop range is empty, so the whole project is exported.
studio.command_warning_largeExport: The 20,000-event safety budget was reached; remaining events were skipped.
studio.command_warning_invalidVisualizerOrigin: The visualizer origin was invalid and was safely replaced with the playback position.
studio.command_warning_visualizerOptionsClamped: One or more visualizer options were outside their safe limits and were normalized.
studio.command_warning_legacyVisualizer: Minecraft 1.13 cannot use the managed entity visualizer safely; it is degraded to short-lived particles.
studio.command_warning_soundStopRangeOverlap: A ranged Sound Stopper shares a sound ID with tracks outside its range; Minecraft will stop every instance of that sound ID.
studio.nbs_description: Import NBS v0–v6 or portable OpenNBS zipped songs, and write either format at any target version.
studio.nbs_import_hint: Converts layers, N/4 meter, header tempo plus Tempo Changer events, velocity, note pan, extended/fine pitch, looping, and resolvable custom samples. Quantized or unsupported details are reported.
studio.nbs_export_hint: Plain .nbs stores sound references only. Zipped song adds every available custom instrument sample under sounds/.
studio.midi_description: Import Standard MIDI Files and record live MIDI keyboards from one workflow.
studio.midi_file_hint: Safely parses formats 0/1, tempo maps, meter, GM programs, drums, velocity, and pitch bend onto the 20 TPS grid.
studio.midi_mapping_gm: Keep original GM sound IDs (external sounds)
studio.midi_tail_fade_hint: Keeps the gated note head and adds alternating per-tick tail voices. Start and End are percentages of the imported head velocity.
studio.midi_tail_fade_single_shot: Tail fade requires Note-off gate mode, matching OpenNBS Note Duration semantics.
studio.midi_preview_stats: Format {{format}} · {{duration}} s / {{ticks}} ticks · {{tracks}} tracks · {{channels}} channels · {{notes}} notes
studio.midi_preview_rows_omitted: +{{count}} track/channel rows omitted from this bounded table
studio.midi_preview_warnings_omitted: +{{count}} additional warnings omitted from this bounded list
studio.midi_live_hint: Records input at the current playhead with note-off gates, pitch-bend updates, and sustain-pedal timing.
studio.midi_no_unlocked_track: There is no unlocked track available for recording.
studio.midi_unsupported: Web MIDI is not available in this WebView.
studio.tempo_map_description: Place tempo and meter changes on the fixed 20 TPS timeline. Audio and marker timing never moves.
studio.tempo_map_anchor_hint: A time-signature change starts a new bar and beat at its event tick; tempo-only changes keep the current musical phase.
studio.tempo_map_duplicate_tick: Only one tempo event is allowed at tick {{tick}}.
studio.tempo_map_tick_zero_required: The tempo map must keep its initial event at tick 0.
studio.song_metadata_description: Edit portable song credits and OpenNBS-compatible finite looping in one undoable change.
studio.song_metadata_loop_hint: The repeat count is the number of additional passes after the first play.
studio.song_metadata_advanced_hint: These fields round-trip with NBS headers. Autosave values are metadata only; Knead recovery has separate settings.
studio.song_metadata_stats_readonly: Imported counters are informational and read-only, preventing them from being mistaken for live Knead analytics.
studio.song_metadata_invalid_metadata: One or more metadata fields are outside the safe project limits.
studio.song_metadata_text_budget_error: The combined metadata text exceeds the 4 MiB safety budget.
studio.song_metadata_loop_range_error: Loop start/end must be whole ticks within this 0–{{max}} tick project.
studio.song_metadata_loop_count_error: Times to loop must be a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.

studio.resource_pack_priority_hint: Lowest priority is first; the last pack wins. Add packs one at a time, then reorder before installing.
